core_distinction.describable_or_listed: An entry is 'describable/listed' (可描述) if it appears in 0x9408[0x06000010] subtag 0x0600001A (114 detail records), in 0x9108[0x06000010] subtag 0x06000013 (80 capability IDs), or in the LUMIX Tether popup UI (114 rows in Normal mode, 29 rows in S&Q mode). Being listed in 0x0600001A or rendered by LTMainMovieQualityPopup.qml only proves the camera firmware's detail table and the host UI's table renderer can describe that quality ID—it does NOT prove that selecting or recording it succeeds in the current mode.
core_distinction.selectable_and_persisted: An entry is 'selectable/persisted' (可设置/可读回) only if setting it (via normal camera menu or authorized host action) causes a subsequent readback of 0x9408[0x06000010] to show both 0x06000013 (Quality_mode_Param) == target_id AND 0x0600001A header current_quality_id == target_id, without fallback or error, and can be restored to the dynamically read baseline.
core_distinction.recordable: An entry is 'recordable' (可录制) only if an actual recording starts and completes in that mode and produces a real container/stream file whose independently inspected container atoms, video codec/SPS, pixel dimensions, frame rate, bit depth/chroma, and frame count match the 0x0600001A descriptor.

why_114_vs_80_occurs.mathematical_rule: Across all 114 records in 0x0600001A, the 34 records absent from 0x06000013 are 100% identically characterized by: (pixels > C4K, i.e. 6K/5.9K/5.8K/5.1K/4.8K: 22 records) OR (frame_rate > 59.94p, i.e. 95.90p/119.88p/239.76p: 12 records). All 80 records in 0x06000013 satisfy (pixels <= C4K AND frame_rate <= 59.94p).
why_114_vs_80_occurs.protocol_and_client_explanation: 0x06000013 is the legacy/standard capability enum (RecMovie bitmap x8+0x132b0, used by pre-0x0600001A cameras via adp_LMX_Mov_Config_Get_Quality_Detail_List_From_Built_In_Data), whereas 0x0600001A is the extended 24-byte/record Quality_Detail_List introduced for cameras with >4K OpenGate/high-res and HFR/S&Q modes (USBTHRV160-26). When 0x06000019 succeeds (validDisplayMovQuality x8+0x64370 == 1), LTMainMovieQualityPopup.qml comments out the recMovieCapability(id) check and displays 0x0600001A directly, gated only by S&Q mode (sq_raw == 1 when recordingMode == RM_SQMotion or shotModeStatus == Shot_Mode_Status_Slow_Quick) and media support (sd_raw == 1 || cfexpress_raw == 1).
